a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan of operating to 8 first would almost certainly leave us both dead. The reserve can only save one of us in round 1, so I plan to take 4 now rather than break the deal quietly. If the storm holds off, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4 too.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take anything more.
